test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
What will come at the place of (?)

TAILOR : CLOTH :: POTTER : ?
solution: The logic followed here is : A **"Tailor"** works with **"Cloth"**. Similarly, A **"Potter"** works with **"Clay"**. Hence, the correct answer is **"option (2)"**.
